details:
It would be really useful if VRChat had a proper version management system for avatars, where multiple variants of the same avatar could be grouped under one main avatar entry instead of every version needing to exist as a completely separate upload in the avatar list.

Right now, creators who regularly update their avatars or maintain multiple outfit versions can end up with a very bloated avatar page. For example, one base avatar might have many different outfit uploads, test versions, optimized versions, platform-specific versions, or other variants that all belong to the same avatar but have to be managed separately.

A possible solution would be a “Versions” section for each avatar, where one main avatar entry could contain multiple related versions. These could be organized under the same base avatar/Pipeline ID or under a linked version group.

Example use cases could include:

Different outfits using the same base avatar

Test, release, and backup versions

Optimized versions for performance

Public and private variants

PC and Quest-related variants

SFW and NSFW variants, where applicable

This would make avatar management much cleaner for creators, especially those who actively maintain their avatars and upload changes regularly. It would also make it easier to keep track of which versions belong together, reduce clutter in the avatar list, and make long-term avatar maintenance less painful.
title: Avatar Version Management Under One Main Avatar Entry
